heuristics.name: material-and-mobility
heuristics.plan: Win material, and keep your options open.

heuristics.name: Give it all away
heuristics.plan: Shed pieces as fast as possible, offering captures every move and valuing whatever is left as little as possible.

heuristics.name: Self-stalemate squeeze
heuristics.plan: Aim to be the side with no legal move at all: bury your own pieces on the edges, block your pawns, and keep your move count tiny.

heuristics.name: Last-of-a-kind sprint
heuristics.plan: Pick one piece type and dump every copy of it, since running out of a kind ends the game in your favour.

heuristics.name: Contrary hoarder
heuristics.plan: Keep your army intact and force the opponent's compulsory captures to eat their own freedom, then hand over the pile all at once.

heuristics.name: Pawn dumper
heuristics.plan: Race pawns up the board so they must be taken or promote into throwaway material, clearing your own ranks bare.
